verdict.rationale: Docs describe a sandbox domain for quick test sends and a low free tier (100 emails/day per docs-42), implying some real-world sending is possible beyond a demo, but community reports confirm Mailgun cut its free tier from 10k to 625 emails/month and removed inbound routing from free plans entirely, significantly limiting real-user validation (mailgun-comm-1, mailgun-comm-2, mailgun-comm-3). This shows the free tier can technically deliver to real users but with harsh caps that frustrated long-time users. missing for 10: clear vendor documentation of current free-plan email caps/limits, evidence that free tier suffices for meaningful founder validation without hitting the 625/month wall, and confirmation inbound testing works on free tier.
